metadata.title: Ten Faces in Every Zone: Lean 4 formalization (PALOMAR-2026-11-20-000013)
metadata.description:
Lean 4 formalization accompanying DICTO's paper #115, Ten Faces in Every Zone (doi:10.5281/zenodo.24389006). It proves: An answer to Grünbaum's zone question (Math. Intelligencer 32(4), 2010) for k = 10: there is a polyhedron of spherical type whose 30 faces are congruent golden rhombi, in which every zone has exactly 10 faces, and whose lattice translates tile space face to face; the zone definition is calibrated on the cube (4) and the rhombic dodecahedron (6).

Built with Lean 4 (leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0-rc2) with Mathlib at commit 0653561 (tag v4.35.0-rc2). This archive is the GitHub repository DICTOR-Master/grunbaum-k10-lean at commit a6b16c25d80fa90ea28259bad6a53d7e81d01779, registered in the Palomar registry as PALOMAR-2026-11-20-000013-v1 at this commit; every proof is checked by the Lean kernel.
